patterns: How do I find your physical store?
responses: You can find our flagship retail locations in major downtown shopping districts. Visit our website store locator for exact addresses and interactive directions.
Our main store is located at 100 Retail Boulevard, City Center. We also have branches in North Plaza and West Mall.

patterns: How do I return a product?
How many days do I have to return an item?
responses: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy for all unworn or defective items with valid receipt. Refunds are issued to your original payment method.
You can return any purchased item within 30 days of purchase with receipt for a full refund or exchange.

patterns: How can I track my order?
responses: You can track your order status by logging into your account dashboard or entering your Tracking ID on our delivery portal.
Please provide your Order ID or check your email for the shipment tracking link sent upon dispatch.

patterns: What payment options do you accept?
Can I pay with credit card?
Do you accept Apple Pay or Google Pay?
responses: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery at select locations.
We accept all major credit/debit cards, contactless mobile payments, digital wallets, and store gift cards.

patterns: Are there any active sales or discounts?
responses: Yes! Join our Smart Retail Loyalty Club for 15% off your first order, plus earn rewards points on every purchase.
Check our Promotions banner online or ask any store representative about today's seasonal sales!

patterns: How do I talk to a human agent?
responses: You can reach our human support team 24/7 at support@smartretail.com or call toll-free at 1-800-SMART-RETAIL.
Our customer representative team is available via telephone at 1-800-555-0199 or via live agent chat on our main site.
